title: Crypto Mining Tycoon Beginner Tips: 6 Ways to Start Strong
subtitle: A calm first-hour plan for a new miner.
description: Crypto Mining Tycoon beginner tips: how to tap for combos, spend coins, finish challenges, use energy and time your first prestige in this idle game.
card: Six practical beginner tips for Crypto Mining Tycoon: combos, upgrades, challenges, energy and your first prestige.

faq.q: How does the combo work in Crypto Mining Tycoon?
faq.a: Quick taps raise a combo counter. The multiplier starts after 10 taps, reaches about 1.8x at 100 and 3.5x at 1000, and is capped at 10x. Critical hits pay 50 times a normal tap.

faq.q: How much offline income can I collect?
faq.a: By default you can collect up to 12 hours of offline income when you return. Some store items, such as the Offline Vault and the Whale Card, raise that limit to 24 hours.

faq.q: When should I do my first prestige?
faq.a: The first prestige needs 1 billion coins. Press it when the Prestige tab shows the gain is clearly larger than your current multiplier, then rebuild. Later levels cost roughly 10 times more each.
